info.title: v2.video.get_user_demographics
info.description: Get user demographics data to better understand the types of viewers that watch your Shopee Video.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/video/get_user_demographics?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp&user_id=user_id',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: error
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate error type if hit error. Empty if no error happened.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: message
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate error details if hit error. Empty if no error happened.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: request_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The identifier for an API request for error tracking.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: age
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The age distribution of your viewers. Note: The type of age is a map. The key is an enumerated value corresponding to an age range: -1: Unknown 1: 18-24 years old 2: 25-34 years old 3: 35-44 years old 4: 45+ years old The value is the number of viewers in each age group.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: gender
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The gender distribution of your viewers. Note: The type of gender is a map. The key is one of: Male Female Predicted Male Predicted Female The value is the number of viewers for each gender type.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: location
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The geographic distribution of your viewers. Note: The type of location is a map. The key is top 10 city, and the value is the number of viewers in each city.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: identity
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The distribution of viewers based on whether they follow your Shopee Video profile. Note: The type of identity is a map. The key is either "follow" or "unfollow", indicating followers and non-followers respectively, and the value is number of page views generated by each group.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: activity
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The distribution of video views across different hours of the day. Note: The type of activity is a map. The key is the hour of the day (ranging from 0 to 23), and the value is the number of video views generated during that specific hour.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: content
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The types of videos that your viewer is most interested in. Note: The type of content is a map. The key is top 10 content category, and the value is the number of video views corresponding to that content category.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: shopping
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The types of products that your viewers is most interested in. Note: The type of shopping is a map. The key is top 10 product category, and the value is the number of video views corresponding to that product category.
